env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '

cd a
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_composite_imported_named.lgo main.lgo
logos eject -o out
cd out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_composite_imported_named.out
cd ..
rm out

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/ccimported

go 1.27
